title: Tiny GPT: A Character-Level Transformer
blurb: Implement causal self-attention and train a small language model that generates text.
brief: Build a small decoder-only transformer language model: a character-level tokenizer, token and positional embeddings, masked multi-head self-attention, feed-forward blocks with residual connections and layer norm, a training loop with cross-entropy loss, and a text generation function with temperature and top-k sampling. Train it on a text corpus (public-domain books work well) and document what the samples look like as training progresses and as you change model size.
requirements: A tokenizer with encode/decode and a vocabulary built from the corpus
Scaled dot-product attention with a causal mask and multiple heads
Transformer blocks with layer normalization and residual connections
A training loop with cross-entropy loss, an optimizer and train/validation loss reporting
deliverables: Loss curves and sample text at several checkpoints
Tests for the causal mask and the tokenizer round-trip
A write-up of how block count, heads and context length affected results
stretch: KV caching in the generation loop
resume_bullet: Implemented and trained a GPT-style transformer (causal multi-head attention, layer norm, residuals) from scratch, with temperature/top-k sampling.
